mapper.sql: SELECT t.plan_id AS planId, t.plan_no AS planNo, t.store_id AS storeId, st.store_name AS storeName, t.plan_name AS planName, t.plan_type AS planType, t.sale_price AS salePrice, t.original_price AS originalPrice, t.valid_days AS validDays, t.total_times AS totalTimes, t.gift_times AS giftTimes, t.stored_amount AS storedAmount, t.support_course_type AS supportCourseType, t.is_private_bind_coach AS isPrivateBindCoach, t.custom_coach_id AS customCoachId, coach.coach_name AS customCoachName, t.custom_member_ids AS customMemberIdsRaw, t.bind_course_id AS bindCourseId, c.course_name AS bindCourseName, t.sort_no AS sortNo, t.status AS status, t.remark AS remark, t.create_time AS createTime

FROM fit_card_plan t LEFT JOIN fit_store st ON st.store_id = t.store_id AND st.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_coach coach ON coach.coach_id = t.custom_coach_id AND coach.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_course c ON c.course_id = t.bind_course_id AND c.del_flag = '0' WHERE t.del_flag = '0'
